invariants: transactional communications are not suppressed merely because promotional consent is absent
promotional communications require explicit promotional opt-in
channel suppression is enforced independently of communication class
canonical event plus template version plus channel is idempotent
notification delivery failure never mutates or rolls back the triggering financial or fulfillment event
failed deliveries retain retry count and failure evidence
delivery state transitions are ordered QUEUED -> SENT -> DELIVERED
promotional frequency caps apply without blocking transactional notices
member/event binding fails closed on mismatch
templates are versioned and communication records retain template identity
consent versions must advance monotonically and every accepted preference change appends immutable consent history
durable outbox uniqueness prevents duplicate enqueue for the same canonical event, template version and channel
parallel dispatch claims use PostgreSQL row locking with SKIP LOCKED and a bounded lease
provider delivery evidence is bound to the exact leased communication record and provider message identifier
in-app communications are projected from the same durable outbox rather than a separate source of truth
subscription reminder event identifiers are deterministic so repeated scheduler runs cannot manufacture duplicate reminders

memberExperience.payment: Food Club communicates canonical payment state; provider receipts are corroborating evidence, not the member-facing source of truth.
memberExperience.refund: REFUND_PROCESSING and REFUND_COMPLETED are separate communications; completion cannot be announced while provider/canonical state remains pending.
memberExperience.subscription: fee reminders and overdue notices are transactional service communications generated by a deterministic scheduler seam.
memberExperience.demandFormation: group-buy commitment progress is promotional and cannot use invented scarcity or bypass promotional consent
